description: Sanctions screening of a company name (OFAC, US, UK, EU, Canada), cheapest tier: is this company sanctioned? One call checks the US Consolidated Screening List (incl. OFAC SDN), the UK Sanctions List, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list and Canada's autonomous sanctions list, refreshed daily.
